questions.stem: An isosceles triangle has two equal sides of $10\text{ cm}$ and a base of $12\text{ cm}$. What is the perpendicular height from the base to the apex?
questions.explanation: The perpendicular bisects the base, creating a right triangle with hypotenuse $10$ and base $6$. Height $= \sqrt{10^2 - 6^2} = \sqrt{100 - 36} = \sqrt{64} = 8\text{ cm}$.
